instructions.notes: Developer/system instruction block; prompt content is always redacted in fixtures.

tools.notes: Function, namespace, and web-search tool declarations.

parallel_tool_calls.notes: Controls whether multiple tool calls may be emitted.

text.notes: Output format settings; retain only when a tested Codex version sends it.

stream.notes: Must be true for the captured SSE contract.

stream_options.notes: Record shape, but do not forward unsupported stream controls.

store.notes: Codex sends false; the gateway does not persist upstream responses.

service_tier.notes: Do not let a client-selected tier change the compatibility path.

prompt_cache_key.notes: Preserve only as a cache hint; redact the value in fixtures.

metadata.notes: Never forward arbitrary client metadata without an explicit policy.

client_metadata.notes: Codex transport metadata is structural context and is redacted.

previous_response_id.notes: Required to preserve continuation semantics when supplied.

background.notes: Not part of the first vertical slice; do not silently emulate it.
